subject: Combine SNP and SilicoDArT marker data for singular analyses

messages.author: 68d520d78998a13e
messages.subject: Combine SNP and SilicoDArT marker data for singular analyses
parts:
Hello,

I have been or am planning to run standard diversity and population structure analysis such as PCA, DAPC, Fst, AMOVA, etc with my DArTseqLD data which includes 11658 SNP and 580 SilicoDArT markers. I would like to be able to combine this marker information if possible to have a better, potentially more informative overall picture. I know that gl.join only allows genlight objects to be either DNP or SilicoDArT data, not a mixture. Is there any way to combine and analyze them in dartr? If not, is there any alternative package, format, etc that can be recommended? In general, is it worth trying to combine the two marker types?

Thanks so much for your time.

Nicole

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Combine SNP and SilicoDArT marker data for singular analyses
parts:
Hi Nicole,

SilicoDArT are dominant markers whereas SNPs are co-dominant markers.
They vary in the information they supply and how they are genotyped.
You can read more information about their differences the attached article.
The equations and, hence, the code required to analyse them are distinct.
I am unaware of any method that combines these.

Cheers,
Luis
